The company positions Intel Foundry as a systems foundry for the AI era, combining process technology, design ecosystem, and packaging to deliver optimized solutions [S7].

- AMD's FY2024 revenue was $25,785,000,000 for the period from 2023-12-31 to 2024-12-28 [F1]. Revenue growth in FY2024 was driven by the Data Center and Client segments [S9]. Data Center net revenue increased to $12.6 billion, up 94% from FY2023, due to higher sales of AMD Instinct™ GPUs and AMD EPYC™ CPUs [S9]. Client segment net revenue rose to $7.1 billion, up 52% from FY2023, primarily from higher sales of AMD Ryzen™ mobile and desktop processors [S9]. Client and Gaming segment net revenue rose to $14.6 billion, up 51% from FY2024, driven by strong demand for AMD Ryzen™ processors, semi-custom game console SoCs, and Radeon™ gaming GPUs [S15]. Embedded segment revenue decreased slightly to $3.5 billion, down 3% from FY2024, as end market demand remained mixed [S15].
